title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. saharae
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. saharae, commonly known as Desert Marigold or Sahara Marigold, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. saharae include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
